anomalies.title: One-Way Mode Multi-Entry Blending Violates Logical Position Isolation
anomalies.description: Bybit perpetual connector operates in One-Way Mode (positionIdx=0). When the strategy receives a second entry signal in the same symbol and side while a previous trade (or runner) is open, Bybit aggregates them into a single exchange position with a weighted blended entry price. However, the bot's internal state tracks them as separate dictionary entries.
anomalies.impact: Hedge Mode does NOT resolve this because Hedge Mode only isolates Buy from Sell, not multiple concurrent Buys or multiple concurrent Sells.
anomalies.remediation: Enforce a strict Concurrency Mutex blocking new entries on the same symbol and side while any parent position (or runner) is open, or use subaccounts.

anomalies.title: T-12 Stop Executed 5020 CHIP via Exchange Clamping, Swallowing T-05 Remainder
anomalies.description: Root Cause: Order 3ba934f0-1bff-4a0a-90dd-6bbc01c4ad12 (CID H-S-896351516234-BB) was created with qty=6870, closeOnTrigger=True, reduceOnly=True. At BE (22:11:41), triggerPrice amended to 0.05737. After TP1 (22:18:33, 3430 CHIP), the bot DID NOT amend the stop order's quantity to 3440. At 22:36:36, when price hit 0.05737, Bybit's exchange matching engine clamped the unamended stop to the open position size (5020 CHIP) and executed it. This swallowed T-05's 1580 CHIP runner. The bot merely reacted to size=0 with a synthetic cleanup (SYNTH_FLAT_18400454197).
anomalies.impact: Position isolation is completely broken; prior trade's stop is invalidated and closed without execution of its own stop order.
anomalies.remediation: Do not allow multi-entry on the same side without subaccount isolation, and ensure stop quantities are explicitly amended after TP1.

anomalies.title: Stop Loss Cancel-Replace / Transition Latency Window
anomalies.description: When rotating or resizing stop orders, network latency creates a window where the exchange position may be unprotected. Without microsecond-level exchange matching engine telemetry, unbroken stop protection is unverifiable.
anomalies.impact: Potential flash-crash exposure during order transitions.
anomalies.remediation: Use Bybit /v5/order/amend endpoint rather than cancel-and-replace.
